Review Text:
I am rewriting this review, as my first review was softly forced. The pilot stopped the golf cart near the hangars and asked us to click the links and do the review on the spot…and then he checked our phones to see that the reviews were completed with a thank you screen showing. While I understand they need reviews as a small business, soft forcing and checking doesn’t feel like it’s the right way to do it. I’ve been on other plane tours around a couple of the other Hawaiian Islands, so I have reference points for comparison.

Pros: We did a custom tour, which is supposed to be a combination of two tours, with circumnavigation of Maui and a tour of the surrounding islands. The views of Molokai and the surrounding area were fantastic. The pilot, Eric, was skillful and we felt safe. He was a nice guy and tried his best to be a good guide.

Cons: (1) I feel like the price of our combined tour was a bit high (around 1250 for two people) especially considering the total time was only about 1.7 hours, which is about the time of just one tour. I feel like more time could have been spent around west Maui , Molokai/Lanai and Molokini rather than Hanna, which is comparatively not that impressive. I would not recommend our tour to others, based on my experience and at this price point. (2) They could use newer planes. The current single engine plane (Piper Archer) is very old. The exterior looks old and the interior is in rough shape. Again, it was safe, but the plane could at least use a new coat of paint, the seats need to be re-upholstered and the interior needs a good cleaning/vacuuming and wipe down. Also, the control pod of my headphones was coming apart with interior wires showing, and all the headphones had earmuff covers that were dirty and almost coming off…they could use disposable ear muff covers and mouthpiece covers…these things are very cheaply available on Amazon. Finally, the pilot’s clothes looked like they were not washed for weeks. Again, I think the pilot is a nice guy and I have nothing against him, but both my wife and I noticed this and thought it was strange. Cleanliness is very important…it’s the first things people notice and experience. These are simple things to fix. (3) They really need a shared office or at least a hangar where customers can sit down and wait and get checked in etc. It seems all they have is a parking spot on the tarmac and a golf cart that they use to get customers directly from their cars. This is ok, but this is just a tip based on what I’ve seen with other tour operators.

I would recommend this company over a helicopter tour because it is better for a small group. However, I would like to see some of the things I mentioned to change. They have been in business for 7 years. So I feel like some of these things should be addressed for their benefit and that of future customers. All they have to do is go experience some other airplane tours on other islands (like Kauai for example) to get more tips on how to improve.

Review Text: Whale watching with Pacific Whale was wonderful, as always. Went a little earlier this year in the hope of seeing more whales. Did see more baby whales but fewer competition groups (where the male whales are showing off to attract the females by breaching & slapping the water). Arrived in Maui 2/20/23. Left 3/1/23. More rain than usual. Three trips with Pacific Whale - snorkeling, whale watching & dinner cruise. All were first rate. In addition to whales, saw Bottle Nose Dolphins, Spinner Dolphins & crew member thought she spotted Hammerhead Shark. Trip to Haleakeala to see the sunrise is always "iffy" and was a disappointment this time. It was clear and warm when we boarded the tour bus at the ocean at 2 a.m. but, by the time we reached the crater, it was 40 degrees. raining, windy & so foggy you couldn't see anything. The breakfast on the way back down, however, almost made up for the disappointment.

Review Text: 5STARS ALL THE WAY: once in a lifetime moment! OK but so this is really a response to another  4 star review that honestly I had a problem with reading because everyone is such a critic these days and so easy to just put your low blood sugar moment on the internet forever and end up not realizing it: My Son and I had the time of our lives, he’s 5 and flew until he got bored, our flight was exactly as expected and even more! We appreciated being asked to leave our feedback to this small business who makes real effort to provide the experience of a lifetime!    We were given our photos BEFORE paying, not after, and the pilot only stood over us to give us shade from the hot sun!  He was trying to guide us, nothing more!  He helped us through the review process which to be honest isn’t as simple as you might think and we’re happy to support such passionate and kind people!  They were so kind and helpful throughout and the only reason they would suggest what to say is obviously when told “ummm, I don’t know what to say”.  So here’s the thing, clearly we had the time of our lives, a thousand people did, and one person clearly just goes on vacation looking for nitpicking things to Yelp about, well, we wanted our 4 Star 5 Star review to put some balance into things for this passionate operator. We Enjoyed every minute! Professional Fun and so so Classy!  More than memorable! The best!  This is my honest review based on my own tour experience and wanted to support this truly exceptional small business. Thanks so much!

Review Text:
The views you get on this tour are breath taking. There are places on the islands you would never be able to see except by small plane or boat which makes the entire experience exceptional.
This is a small business so changes are possible but not cancelations. In their fine print it clearly explains that any refunds are at their discretion so be mindful of that.
The only thing I really didn't like and the reason I deducted 1 star is because when the trip was over and the operator had been paid we were held up until everyone completed their review and he stood over everyone in the group to ensure he only received 5 star reviews and even coached what he thought you should write. I didn't like that. If people feel pressured to write you a 5 star review, how honest is it? Let the tour speak for itself.
Also, the ad says you do as much or as little as you want, that it's a flying lesson but really its just a photo op. You really only take the controls for a few minutes. Long enough for him to take a picture of you with your hands on the controls, and he held the pictures he took for us until he got all of his 5 star reviews from each of us.
It was a worthwhile experience. Total expenses out the door including tip it was just under a $1000 for 3 people for about an hour of actual flying.

Review Title: Bucket list item, check!  If not on your list, perhaps it should be :)
Review Text:
My wife and I are from Vancouver, Canada and were celebrating our 30th anniversary on Maui (so nice to travel a bit after these last few years). We really wanted to imprint an experience into our memory of something so special and beyond what our '30 year ago' selves could guess we could do.

There really are no words to describe how superb and wonderful this experience is. You will see views only seen by an exceptionally small amount of humanity and will likely find it hard to not be awe-struck. We had Eric as our pilot and he skillfully navigated the tour-guide of the flight along with the flying and ATC interaction. He gave my flying tips that no other instructor ever did (and what a place to receive them!).

Long story short (as I could go on for many more paragraphs); if you want a lifetime memory and can find a way to line up a time to get in the air, it will be something I suspect you will treasure as much as we do.

Review Text: My husband and I were originally looking for a helicopter experience, but were given the suggestion by our concierge to go on a more intimate plane ride with Eric of Maui Plane Rides. We were able to see all the views and sights that we had wanted to see in a helicopter, but in a much more intimate setting. Eric was a wonderful tour guide, giving us tons of information about what we were seeing. We were flying during the humpback whale season, and any time we saw a whale, he would circle around so we could see it better. The whole experience felt very personalized. He took some photos for us and after the flight, gave us a nice cold drink which was much appreciated! Out of all of our honeymoon activities, this one was my favorite, and I highly recommend Maui Plane Rides to anyone looking for an amazing aerial experience.

Review Title: Island views on a perfect weather day
Review Text: Looking for a flight around Maui and other neighboring islands that are part of Maui County? We were and found Maui Plane Rides a great choice for seeing various landscapes and to have great views of Maui mountains on one of the clearest mornings possible. The pilot was very responsive to a last minute flight request; we had waited for better weather and visibility that happened to be our last day on the island. We were able to see sea cliffs, lush green and more rugged landscapes, ports and other special features that make Maui County special and memorable. A great day to fly with lower winds and visibility to Big Island in the distance. Wonderful photo options from both sides of the plane that we will cherish as memories for years to come! Small plane accommodations for taller and average size tourists, comfortable seating and communications. Smooth take-off and landing with little wind turbulence coming around mountainous areas to be expected. Worth the cost compared to other flights; same cost for up to three people, so both of us got to fly on a beautiful morning flight to start the day! Thanks so much to our pilot for the touring info of each location and great memories of favorite beaches and the blue/aqua waters with mountain backdrops made with photos options!
